jobs.description:
Overview:We're looking for a skilled and experienced Automation / Senior Engineer to join our team for an exciting project. In this role, you will be key to designing, integrating, and following up on critical safety and automation systems. You will develop detailed SAS Safety system designs, ensuring they align with project requirements and seamlessly integrate with existing plant infrastructure.This position involves close collaboration with other disciplines, contractors, suppliers, and clients. If you're a proactive problem-solver with a background in automation engineering and SIS system design, and you thrive in a collaborative, multicultural environment, we'd love to hear from you!Main Tasks:
• System Design, interface, and follow up of ESD, PSD and F&G System as appointed by automation team lead.
• Develop SAS Safety system design according to project needs.
• Design and specify SIS solutions that are aligned with existing plant, for integration of SIS systems.
• Specification of Global SIS system design through contractual interfaces.
• Participation in multidiscipline reviews.
• Ensure that vendor and engineering information needed for progress of the work is identified and communicated to the project.
• Interface to other disciplines, contractors, suppliers and client.
• Offshore survey may be required.Qualifications:
• Minimum 8 years’ experience from automation engineering in green field projects.
• Minimum 5 years’ experience from automation and SIS system design, including experience with brownfield modifications on a SIS system.
• Experience in automation design and networks according to relevant standards such as NORSOK, ATEX, PTIL, and IEC.
• FSE-course.
• Ex-course.
• Efficient communicator in English - both orally and in writing.If you're excited by this opportunity, we encourage you to apply!
